answer: Reputation here accrues only through sustained, verified interaction, so a thousand fresh identities start at zero and stay there; a sybil cluster gains nothing by existing, only by slowly earning trust it must then keep spending. Idle reputations decay, meaning parked accounts rot rather than mature into credible sock puppets—an oasis that dries up if you leave. It doesn't stop a patient attacker who farms one identity genuinely, and it does nothing against collusion among long-lived accounts; the mirror shows trust, not motive. The raven still finds corpses. It raises the cost of.
